name: feature.sales-commissions.agents
description: Sales Commissions agent pack — an advisory Commissions Analyst whose tools are the feature.sales-commissions.nodes READ nodes over ctx.features.commissions. It answers questions about commission plans and statements (subject-scoped) and PROPOSES plan changes — a human disposes. Tool-allowlisted to reads ONLY: computing or approving a statement are governed admin ops behind the host:commissions:manage HTTP routes, never a direct agent tool call (the CRM stance — payout-affecting writes stay human-gated). Driven through the ONE existing chat, scoped to this agent — no second chat panel.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Commissions Analyst Agent
agents.description: Reads an org's commission plans and statements (via feature.sales-commissions.nodes over ctx.features.commissions) to answer comp questions and explain how a rep's statement was computed. Proposes plan/accelerator changes; it never computes or approves a statement — those are human-gated admin ops.
